requirement: v3.2.0: w2m speaks the independently published, versioned interop contract SDK (@twinsearth/dsh-fang-contract 1.1.1) for w2m <-> dsh-fang and w2m <-> dsh-master interop: own w2m.* method table, server (local service + /api/w2m/contract routes + optional file fallback), client with local->http->file->legacy downgrade, and byte-identical vendored SDK copy; no dsh-fang or dsh-master source is imported or modified

assertions.independence: the three projects stay independent: w2m imports no dsh-fang or dsh-master source, modifies neither tree, and depends only on the published @twinsearth/dsh-fang-contract package, whose 1.1.1 files are vendored byte for byte under src/interop/contract/ with sha256 recorded in PROVENANCE.md
assertions.methodTable: w2m.* methods at contractVersion 1.0.0: w2m.status, w2m.methods, w2m.fleet.snapshot, w2m.devices.list, w2m.tasks.list; the SDK protocol (fang-master v1) and contract package version (1.1.1) stay separate from the plugin version (3.2.0)
assertions.server: createW2mContractServer wraps the SDK server; apply() provides w2mContract, yields the fangContract name only when it is free, registers /api/w2m/contract/{hello,health,invoke} on the connection registry and mounts the SDK file contract server when fileDir is configured
assertions.client: createW2mContractClient reuses the SDK router, so local -> http -> file -> legacy downgrade works; the legacy hop calls the 3.1.x service keys (fangForker etc.) as the last resort
assertions.suites: contract-interop 9/9; layer model and claims 71 pass with 1 network skip; vendor checker 9/9 files match PROVENANCE.md
assertions.no_fake_data: a handler without an injected provider answers handler-threw carrying w2m-service-absent instead of returning empty success data
assertions.artifact: scripts/pack.mjs packs dist/twinsearth-w2m-dsh-plugin-3.2.0.tgz deterministically; the published sha256 is the one release.yml writes into dist/SHA256SUMS, so the record does not restate the hash of the archive that contains it
